name: Saaria Wynes
source:
Saaria is a super clumsy, but also hardworking girl. She runs the Wynes Magic Store alone on behalf of her sick mother.

[spoiler]She's actually the Wynes Magic Store's owner's familiar permanently shapeshifted for five years into her deceased daughter through the power of the angels.[/spoiler]

[Translated from [url=https://www.kogado.com/sw/contents/kuroneko/as/char.htm]the game's Official Homepage[/url].]
